description: The current gold/silver ratio (ounces of silver one ounce of gold buys at spot), with an optional swap: give gold_oz to see the silver ounces it equals, or silver_oz for the gold ounces. Spot-to-spot only; premiums and buy-back spreads are not included. Use when the user asks for the gold/silver ratio or a spot-to-spot conversion. Read-only.

gold_oz.description: Gold ounces to convert into silver ounces

silver_oz.description: Silver ounces to convert into gold ounces
